claims.question: Within how many minutes must a mine operator call MSHA after an accident that kills a miner?
claims.claim: The operator must contact MSHA immediately and within 15 minutes of knowing or should knowing that a death occurred.
claims.quote: The operator shall immediately contact MSHA at once without delay and within 15 minutes at the toll-free number, 1-800-746-1553, once the operator knows or should know that an accident has occurred involving: (a) A death of an individual at the mine;
claims.reason: The quote explicitly states the operator must contact MSHA immediately, within 15 minutes, once knowing or should know a death occurred, matching the claim exactly.

claims.question: How long must the self-rescue device given to each underground coal miner be able to protect that person?
claims.claim: Each operator shall make available to each miner who goes underground an approved self-rescue device adequate to protect such person for 1 hour or longer.
claims.quote: Each operator shall make available to each miner who goes underground, and to visitors authorized to enter the mine by the operator, an approved self-rescue device or devices which is adequate to protect such person for 1 hour or longer.
claims.reason: The quote explicitly states operators must provide each miner an approved self-rescue device adequate to protect the person for 1 hour or longer, matching the claim exactly.

claims.question: How often must an underground metal or nonmetal mine hold evacuation drills?
claims.claim: At least once every six months, mine evacuation drills shall be held to assess the ability of all persons underground to reach the surface or other designated points of safety within the time limits of the self-rescue devices.
claims.quote: At least once every six months, mine evacuation drills shall be held to assess the ability of all persons underground to reach the surface or other designated points of safety within the time limits of the self-rescue devices that would be used during an actual emergency.
claims.reason: The quote contains the exact claim text verbatim, with only a trailing clause added that does not alter the claim's meaning.

claims.question: How often must an underground metal or nonmetal mine hold evacuation drills?
claims.claim: Drills must be held for each shift at a time other than shift change, involve all persons underground, activation of the fire alarm system, and evacuation to the surface or central evacuation points.
claims.quote: The evacuation drills shall—(1) Be held for each shift at some time other than a shift change and involve all persons underground; (2) Involve activation of the fire alarm system; and (3) Include evacuation of all persons from their work areas to the surface or to designated central evacuation points.
claims.reason: The quote matches all elements of the claim: per-shift timing other than shift change, all persons underground, fire alarm activation, and evacuation to surface or designated central evacuation points.
